slides.title: Oxytocin: the “love hormone”?
slides.text: A trust spray sounds great. What does the research say? 👉

slides.title: A 9-amino-acid peptide
slides.text: A hormone made in the brain. In medicine it's an established obstetric drug, e.g. to induce labor and treat postpartum bleeding.

slides.title: One study from 2005
slides.text: A study in Nature suggested nasal oxytocin increases trust. Media turned it into the “love hormone”.
Replication attempts kept failing. A 2015 review found no robust evidence, and a large 2020 replication study did not confirm the effect.
Peptide catalog, myths vs facts, FDA decision timeline.

caption:
Oxytocin: the “love hormone”? 💞 In obstetrics it's a proven medicine, but the “trust spray” has no robust evidence. Later research didn't confirm the famous 2005 result.
